title: fix(cli): os deploy takes --confirm-global-uniques on a self-hosted runtime
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XK6xDkLoiBC4HTcoqUryg5E)_
Fixes #31338

Clause-②: yes — `os deploy` gains an accepted flag (`--confirm-global-uniques`), widening a published CLI command's accept set; the seat's own review of the declaration is owed before landing
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os deploy` 新增 `--confirm-global-uniques` 开关，在自托管运行时（`os environments use-runtime`）路径上和已有的两个升级确认（`--confirm-access-upgrade`、`--confirm-upgrade`）走同一处转交给内嵌的 `os package install`；目标是 ObjectOS Cloud 时照两个升级确认的做法，在构建和发送前拒绝。文档 `cli.mdx` 补了这一行。
- 为什么改：自托管部署遇到全局唯一约束停止（`UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`）时，CLI 打印的重试命令是 `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques`，但 `os deploy` 不认这个参数，照抄（尤其是 agent 照抄）会被当未知参数拒绝，部署路径也无法传这个确认。
- 风险与回滚：只加一个可选开关，不传时请求体与以前逐字节相同；`os package install` 和两个升级确认不变；`@objectstack/cli` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` 的 `CONFIRMATION_FLAGS` / `confirmationArgv`（唯一转交处）和 Cloud 拒绝循环；`packages/cli/test/deploy.test.ts` 新增三条用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/deploy.test.ts`，预期 34/34 通过；其中「declares every confirmation flag the embedded install prints」一条在 `os package install` 将来新增确认开关而 `os deploy` 没跟上时会变红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On a self-hosted runtime target, `os deploy` runs `os package install` in-process with `retryCommand = 'os deploy'`, so every stop that install prints names `os deploy` as the retry. The installation-wide uniques stop (`UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, ADR-0120 D5e) printed `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques`, a flag `os deploy` did not declare: oclif refused it as an unknown flag (exit 2), and the deploy path had no way to pass the confirmation.

- **`packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts`.** Declares `--confirm-global-uniques` (a boolean, help text naming `os package install --confirm-global-uniques`, as the two upgrade confirmations name theirs). The three confirmations are now one list, `CONFIRMATION_FLAGS`, and one function, `confirmationArgv`, turns the given ones into install argv. `deployToRuntime` takes that argv instead of two token parameters, so there is one forwarding seam and no second copy of the install command's handling. As before, the confirmations go to the install only; the dry run sends none (install-local answers `dryRun` before its uniques gate, `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` `answerUpgradeDryRun` precedes the `GLOBAL_UNIQUE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` stop).
- **ObjectOS Cloud target.** The flag means nothing there, so it is refused before anything is built or sent, exactly as `--confirm-access-upgrade` and `--confirm-upgrade` already are (same loop, same sentence, exit 1).
- **`content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`.** The `os deploy` flag table gains the `--confirm-global-uniques` row; § To a self-hosted runtime step 3 names the three confirmations passed through, the uniques stop, and that the printed retry names `os deploy`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31338-deploy-confirm-global-uniques.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

`install.ts` is untouched: the seam did not need sharing.

## Tests

`packages/cli/test/deploy.test.ts`, in the use-runtime block, three new cases:

1. The uniques stop's retry names `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques`, and `os deploy --confirm-global-uniques` reaches the install with `confirmGlobalUniques: true` (and the dry run without it).
2. Every `confirm-*` flag `os package install` declares is declared by `os deploy` (the class guard: a future install confirmation that `os deploy` does not take reds here).
3. `--confirm-global-uniques` is refused on an ObjectOS Cloud target before anything is built or sent.

CONTROL: the existing access-upgrade and schema-upgrade cases and their Cloud refusals pass unchanged; `test/package-install-dry-run.test.ts` passes unchanged.

<details><summary>Red on main (cases added, source at origin/main e73542555)</summary>

```text
     × the installation-wide uniques stop's retry names os deploy --confirm-global-uniques, and the confirmation passes through
     × declares every confirmation flag the embedded install prints as its retry
     × --confirm-global-uniques is refused when the target is ObjectOS Cloud, before anything is sent
  …or edit the app's metadata to `unique: 'organization'` and rebuild.: expected 2 to be undefined
AssertionError: confirm-global-uniques: expected [ 'env', 'wait', 'wait-timeout', …(4) ] to include 'confirm-global-uniques'
AssertionError: expected 2 to be 1 // Object.is equality
      Tests  3 failed | 31 passed (34)
```

Exit 2 is oclif's unknown-flag refusal: the printed retry was refused.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven blob == HEAD 2b59a9ce9b7f and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

The test imports `../src/commands/deploy.js` directly, so no dist leg applies.

A. Cloud refusal skips the new flag (`|| flag === 'confirm-global-uniques'` in the refusal loop's `continue`):

```text
     × --confirm-global-uniques is refused when the target is ObjectOS Cloud, before anything is sent
AssertionError: expected [ { …(4) } ] to have a length of +0 but got 1
      Tests  1 failed | 33 passed (34)
```

B. The forwarding drops the new flag (`|| flag === 'confirm-global-uniques'` in `confirmationArgv`'s empty return):

```text
     × the installation-wide uniques stop's retry names os deploy --confirm-global-uniques, and the confirmation passes through
AssertionError: expected undefined to be true // Object.is equality
      Tests  1 failed | 33 passed (34)
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-②: yes (widening).** `os deploy`'s accept set grows by one flag; nothing it accepted before is refused, and with the flag absent the install body is byte-identical to before.
- **PR #31335 and `cli.mdx`.** #31335 (skills lane, open) edits `cli.mdx` § `os dev` (around L169-L174) only; this PR edits § `os deploy`'s flag table and § To a self-hosted runtime step 3 (around L3245, L3267). No overlapping hunk, so the doc line stays in this PR; whichever lands second merges cleanly.
- **Not edited here.** The platform skill's use-runtime exit-1 paragraph (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`, added by #31335) is the skills lane's; the line it needs is in the report's `out_of_scope_findings`. The `os deploy` flag table still has no `--confirm-upgrade` row (#31335's "Other sites found" already names it); left alone.
